derivation: affineSegment_image (AffineEquiv.vaddConst R p : V →ᵃ[R] P) x y
explanation: `affineSegment_image` states that any affine map sends an affine segment to the segment between the images of its endpoints. Instantiating the map with `AffineEquiv.vaddConst R p` gives the theorem exactly; the theorem’s existing proof already does this.
